title: FeedItem
description: feed.item@1: one card of OpenVibe's one feed, served by OpenVibe.Network (GET /api/v1/feed and GET /api/frame/feed; OpenVibe.Community's Pulse reads the same feed). Every card names the service it came from, a stable id, its own link, and only public or follower-visible activity. Kinds: post, pic, clip, video, live, stream, rundown, quest, member, chat, event, wiki, update, work, deal, news, report, poll, game, meme, paste, episode, space, avatar, banner, follow, site.

id.description: Stable across feeds and restarts: f:<service>:<type>:<id> for a source item and t:<site>:<url> for a trending card.

kind.description: What happened. live is a channel on air now (a go-live that ended is stream); stream is a past broadcast, including a watched-together summary; work is one grouped row of new jobs per hour; report is a number with its trend.

url.description: The thing itself: the post, stream, job board, report page or wiki page.

text.description: The source's first 280 characters, on one line; empty when it has none.

at.description: When it happened; null only for a trending card.

starts_at.description: When a scheduled event begins; present only on event cards.

site.description: The source service: live, community, media-hub, pics, games, quest, chat, today, work, deals, news, report, wiki, blog, tools, network…

actor.description: Who did it; null for AI, system, aggregate and trending cards. handle and level (1.1.0) let a card name the person (@handle, their level); the name effects come from Inventory by `subject`.

handle.description: The person's username, without the @ (1.1.0). Optional.

level.description: The person's OpenVibe level, when they show it (Network's levels; a person who hides it from the leaderboard sends null) (1.1.0). Optional.

fx.description: The name effect the person wears (Inventory's live.name_effect.css@1 token, e.g. name-fx-rainbow), looked up by the feed's server so no site needs Inventory in its connect-src; openvibe-shared items.css draws it (1.1.0). Optional.

subject.description: The acting person's subject, when one is known; null for AI, system and aggregate cards. The Following filter and For you ranking read it.

media.description: The card's first picture, as a Media thumbnail; null when it has none.

length.description: Seconds, when the card is a video.

counts.description: The numbers the source knows; each present only when it knows it.

watchers.description: People who watched a stream (peak for a past broadcast).

people.description: A count a report card is about (people online, jobs, stories).

live_now.description: Present on live and stream cards: true only while the channel is on air.

trend.description: Present on report cards: which way the number moved and by how much.

group.description: A run of the same kind folded into one card (two or more items).

price.description: What it costs now (1.1.0; deals). Optional.

was.description: What it cost before, in the same currency (1.1.0; deals). Optional.

store.description: Where it is sold (1.1.0; deals). Optional.

label.description: Present only when the card needs one.

visibility.description: Present only for an item returned to a follower or its author; never public.
